lineage.groupingRule: Evaluation groups are connected components formed by shared source base or trajectory overlap meeting the bidirectional coverage criterion. Near-duplicate starts are reported as dependence warnings but do not alone merge groups unless their captured trajectories overlap.

development.primaryEvaluationPopulation: P1 independent randomized_start and target_enriched trajectories only
development.hardCausalUsage: training-only auxiliary observations, excluded whenever their source-base group is the evaluation group; never counted as independent support
development.foldConstruction: Build source-base/spatial connected components first. Sort positive and negative components independently and allocate round-robin to three folds. No component may cross a fold boundary.
development.calibration: Pooled out-of-fold predictions from all three source-base-group-disjoint development folds; confirmation is never used.

candidateSelection.primaryMetric: median seed source-group macro average precision
candidateSelection.rule: Select causal multiview only if its median spatial-group macro AP exceeds single-frame by at least 0.02; otherwise select single-frame. Candidate must also have every-seed pooled AP >= 0.50, recognize at least P-1 of P positive spatial groups at its calibrated threshold, frame recall >= 0.70, and zero observed development false positives.
candidateSelection.thresholdRule: Among unique pooled out-of-fold scores, choose the lowest threshold with zero observed negative predictions; ties maximize frame recall then precision. This is a development operating point, not proof of zero future risk.

training.earlyStopping: patience 16 after epoch 24 on source-group-balanced inner-validation loss; restore best epoch
training.finalRefit: After architecture selection, refit one model per declared seed on all development groups for the median best epoch observed for that seed across outer folds; retain the out-of-fold calibrated threshold unchanged.
training.initialization: PyTorch default initialization after setting the declared seed
training.loss: equal source-group mass, equal positive/negative mass within source group when both exist; BCE STOP plus 0.25 standardized-quality MSE
training.preprocessing: grayscale bilinear resize to 128x128; scalar mean and standard deviation computed on training groups only
models: same CNN encoder causal four-view two-head with actually executed action feedback

confirmation.startingPoseConstruction: Generate from current T6/T7/T8 markers and skin raycasts via deterministic seeded physical sampling; never read or copy a P1 source pose.
confirmation.randomizedRule: One valid T7-region start for each seed with rotating longitudinal stratum, uniform lateral perturbation in [-12,12] mm and fixed yaw strata {-6,-3,0,3,6} deg.
confirmation.targetEnrichedRule: For each seed, generate at most 12 independent marker/skin-derived candidates across longitudinal [-9,9] mm, lateral [-12,12] mm and yaw [-6,6] deg; privileged evaluator selects the highest-score valid candidate before any frame is exposed outside Unity.
confirmation.trajectoryRule: Capture reset plus 80 deterministic safe actuator actions. Random stratum uses seeded balanced actions; enriched stratum uses a frozen local raster/rotation walk. Rejected or incomplete action is stored as RESET for actor features.
confirmation.failurePolicy: Record every failed start attempt and retain every admitted group, including groups with no positive frame. Never add or remove a group after labels are observed.
confirmation.spatialIndependence: Report minimum start-pose and observation-pose distance/angle to all P1 regions using the frozen lineage criteria; overlap is reported, not hidden.
confirmation.isolation: Do not run capture until exactly one architecture, three-seed ensemble checkpoint, preprocessing and threshold are frozen. Capture and confirmation evaluation may each execute once. No post-confirmation tuning.
confirmation.supportTarget: At least six positive source-base-start groups and meaningful negatives; lower support is UNDERPOWERED or INCONCLUSIVE.
